about: tools/smoke.py's replays: titles that once failed, each on its machine with its input, checked at a fixed frame against a reference run. Disk images are not in git: 'disks' names each image's file in the media folder, its MD5 and the TOSEC archive it came from (amigamuseum.emu-france.info/Fichiers/ADF/).

replays.name: lemmings
replays.title: All New World of Lemmings (Hoodlum crack, AGA)
replays.why: the checkpoint: Gayle's overlay latch and the 68EC020's odd-address data reads (2026-11-22); without them an exception loop, or a misleading block 925 read error

replays.name: pango
replays.title: Pango Fun (Heresy crack of a beta)
replays.why: the control: its Guru was the Copper's (DMA off while its list was replaced, 2026-11-22), not the floppy's

replays.name: magician
replays.title: The Magician (PDX crack), no slow RAM
replays.why: with slow RAM this crack fails on any A500: it forces the 512 KB load address, the game's own check then takes its slow-RAM path and loads over its code (2026-11-24)

replays.name: magician-slow
replays.title: The Magician (Angels crack), 512 KB slow RAM
replays.why: the same game with slow RAM, through a crack that keeps the game's own load addresses
